title: Daniel Spellbound
description: In New York City, a teenage tracker makes his living selling hard-to-find mystical items to sorcerers — but dealing in magic can be risky business.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x1
episodes_data.description: To settle his debt with the evil Pie Maker, Daniel must track a rare magical item: the Fugu Rose. But not without the help of a talking pig named Hoagie.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x2
episodes_data.description: During an unexpected visit to the Bureau of Magical Enforcement, the Primus offers to help Daniel out of his deal with Pie Maker — for a price.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x3
episodes_data.description: Daniel's on the hunt for a Boatman Token, which may bring him one step closer to the Gryphon's Egg... if he can find the right item to trade for it.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x4
episodes_data.description: In the wake of a close confrontation — and a narrow escape — Daniel, Lucy and Hoagie travel to Shanghai in search of a royal gem.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x5
episodes_data.description: While Lucy distracts a salesperson at an illegal trading post, Daniel and Hoagie sneak into a vault to steal the heart of the Mermaid Queen.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x6
episodes_data.description: After a run-in with a rival tracker, Daniel and Lucy must barter with gremlins to repair their ice cream truck and resume their magical journey.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x7
episodes_data.description: Daniel and Lucy storm the hive of the Insect King in search of the Key Staff, only to find that someone's already beaten them to it.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x8
episodes_data.description: To hold up their end of the Tracker Code, the trio leads a rival tracker to the Gryphon's lair. But getting out alive? That's another story.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x9
episodes_data.description: Lucy's quick thinking keeps the Gryphon's Egg out of the hands of the Dark Mage… for now. But Daniel worries the egg is too powerful for any one person.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 1x10
episodes_data.description: In a final battle with the Dark Mage, Daniel, Lucy and Hoagie must defend the Gryphon's Egg. The fate of the magical world — and ours — depends on it.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x1
episodes_data.description: To rejoin the Trackers' Guild, Daniel needs an Untrackable — and his new friend Shak knows exactly where to find one.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x2
episodes_data.description: After coming across an unusual shrine in Jayce's hideout, the group travels to the most cursed place on Earth to look for the legendary tracker.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x3
episodes_data.description: Daniel decides to help Jayce track an ancient coffer in exchange for an item he desperately needs... if they can make it off a mysterious island alive.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x4
episodes_data.description: At the illegal trading post, Jayce tries to make good on his deal with Daniel. But first, Daniel must play a sinister game to pay off his debt to Kel.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x5
episodes_data.description: In order to get their hands on Witching Silver, the gang infiltrates a secret forge. Meanwhile, Lucy and Hoagie pay a visit to the oracle.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x6
episodes_data.description: The team astral projects into another realm to figure out the location of the Scepter. There, Daniel learns about his family from an unexpected source.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x7
episodes_data.description: To repair his armor, Daniel will have to strike a deal with a tough-talking fish. Then, Jayce and Shak storm a volcano in search of the Scepter.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x8
episodes_data.description: In Selcouth, the teams must pass four trials to win the Scepter — unless someone untrustworthy beats them to it.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x9
episodes_data.description: A powerful item falls into unexpected hands, leaving Shak to make an impossible choice. Later, Daniel and his friends try to contain a dark force.

episodes_data.title: Daniel Spellbound 2x10
episodes_data.description: Back in New York, the city's greatest magicians combine their powers to battle a formidable foe. But will it be enough to save magic as they know it?
